label: Recorded run of the real Python engine. The AI steps used the offline fixture (a deterministic stand-in, not a model); use AI & Safety, Try a reply, to run the real model. In these scenario runs a test harness (not a person) approves each held email on the spot, so that what happens after approval can be shown.

flows.title: Successful end-to-end flow with grounded personalization
show: I send the list-import event and show it persisted
I load the account, contacts and facts
I show the rules returning ELIGIBLE with the finance director as best contact
I show the AI drafting copy that cites usable fact_ids only
I show the validator accepting it and the approved template with a grounded opening
I show the send landing inside the recipient's window
I close on the audit row: event, state version, decision, reasons, model output, validation verdict, action

flows.title: Duplicate delivery
show: I deliver the same webhook twice and the second is ignored
I deliver the same idempotency key under a new event_id and it is ignored
I deliver the CRM mirror (other source, other key) and it is deduped by content
I show exactly one email and one audit trail

flows.title: Failure: transient error and uncertain outcome
show: I make the send API return 503: backoff, retry, ONE email (same idempotency key)
I make it return 200 with status=unknown: I reconcile by key before any retry and never re-send blindly
I make enrichment fail persistently: retry budget spent, dead-letter, alert, human

flows.title: Ambiguous / unsafe AI output
flows.requirement: one ambiguous or unsafe AI case
show: I replay 'I'm interested but don't write to me again': the model says INTERESTED at 0.96, and my deterministic opt-out guard overrides it to suppress
I replay a prompt injection that the model obeys: the validator rejects it and a human gets it
I replay an ambiguous reply at low confidence: it goes to a human and never auto-acts
I say the honest limit out loud: a plausible, schema-valid, wrong answer passes, and only labelled evals and human sampling catch it

flows.title: Malformed AI output
flows.requirement: AI output may be incomplete, malformed or unsupported by the data
show: I replay truncated JSON: one retry, then escalation
I replay an invented date, referral and team size that are not in the text: escalation, no retry

flows.title: Out-of-order race (late unsubscribe)
flows.requirement: events may arrive delayed or out of order
show: I process the targeting event first, when the state still looks eligible
I deliver the unsubscribe that happened BEFORE it, 20 hours late
I show it applied: the contact is suppressed, anything still pending is cancelled, and because the first email already went out on stale knowledge, a human is flagged (SENT_BEFORE_LATE_FACT)
